goals: Make Block Geometry Extensions geometries participate in Continuity connected-texture behavior when their canonical source or material-family semantics call for connection.
Preserve source-material identity and support applicable BGE-owned geometries consistently without duplicating BGE's canonical geometry ownership, material-family registry, or source-block mappings.
scope: Provide one centralized Fabric block-appearance bridge for Continuity rule selection without generating material- or geometry-specific CTM rules.
Consume BGE's typed runtime binding, canonical parent, and exact effective slab source as the sole geometry-to-material authority rather than inferring families from registry identifiers.
Project only explicitly equivalent canonical material state while keeping geometry form, orientation, waterlogging, and unknown properties out of the canonical appearance.

Filter Continuity neighbor decisions through one same-material surface descriptor using face normal, exact world plane, rendered source-quad bounds, deterministic supported-geometry bounds, and real boundary contact.

Support proven cross-geometry contact among full blocks, exact ordinary slabs, Layers, and Vertical Slabs while leaving Steps, Corners, Quarter Columns, unknown topology, risky visual profiles, and unrelated Continuity behavior unchanged.

exclusions: Continuity remains the target CTM implementation; this project does not replace Continuity or implement a general CTM engine.

BGE retains ownership of geometry registration, geometry ownership, material-family relationships, and source-block mappings; this project must consume those canonical relationships rather than duplicate them or infer them from registry names.
Nibaru retains ownership of its material definitions and semantics.
This project does not modify BGE, Matcha, or unrelated resource-pack artwork during initialization.

Translucent Glass × BGE Compatibility remains a separate project responsible for translucent-glass and rendering compatibility issues that are not general CTM connectivity; this project does not absorb that scope.

dependencies.reason: Block Geometry Extensions owns the typed runtime binding, geometry roles, canonical material identity, and exact effective slab source consumed by Canary 2; C70 is the first controlled compatibility baseline for these API seams.

Canary 2 decorates the exact Continuity 3.0.1+26.2 connection predicate and quad-processing seams so rule selection remains separate from per-face contact eligibility; the required mixins and controlled input hash fail closed on an incompatible implementation.
The appearance and block-state method descriptors are compiled and controlled against Minecraft Java 26.2.
Fabric runtime loader and required Mixin host declared by Canary 2.
Provides the Fabric block appearance, renderer quad, and controlled GameTest APIs used by Canary 2; 0.156.0+26.2 is the exact validation baseline.
Owns the Vertical Slab and Step base classes used by the centralized appearance and geometry policy; 2.0.7+26.2 is the exact controlled baseline.

state.milestone: Canary 2 adds typed canonical rule selection plus a version-bounded Continuity contact filter for exact rendered-quad coplanarity across ordinary slabs, Layers, Vertical Slabs, and full blocks; controlled build, JUnit, and GameTests pass, while Minecraft-client visual CTM remains runtime untested.

exceptions.reason: The appearance bridge is compiled against the Minecraft 26.2 block-state and Fabric appearance method descriptors and must remain on the controlled target release.
regression_evidence: Canary 2 compiles and its focused headless GameTests execute against Minecraft 26.2 and Fabric API 0.156.0+26.2.

exceptions.reason: Canary 2 injects the exact Continuity 3.0.1+26.2 seven-argument ConnectionPredicate neighbor seam; the required mixin and controlled input hash fail closed rather than guessing across an incompatible implementation.
regression_evidence: The exact Continuity 3.0.1+26.2 input is SHA-256 controlled, compiles against the typed ConnectionPredicate seam, and is verified as a required client mixin target.

current.summary: Projects typed BGE material appearances and filters Continuity connections to same-material coplanar contacts across full blocks, ordinary slabs, Layers, and Vertical Slabs.
